record.title: Derivatives clearing organization
kv: The activity falls within the CEA derivatives-clearing function.
Chicago Mercantile Exchange, Inc. (registered or chartered); ICE Clear Credit LLC (registered or chartered)
Derivatives clearing organizations with the required registration or specific applicable relief
Classify the contract and clearing activity. Establish DCO registration or applicable relief and scope. Review membership, margin and default terms.
Securities clearing and derivatives clearing are separate legal tests; named DCO permissions are not assessed here.

Chicago Mercantile Exchange, Inc.: CFTC's list header reads 'Pending - Provisional Registration'; its remarks state that CME Inc. was provisionally registered on November 20, 2012 and identify interest-rate, credit, foreign-exchange, equity, and other-commodity asset classes.
ICE Clear Credit LLC: CFTC's registered-DCO registry lists ICE Clear Credit LLC as registered and identifies its Title VIII SIDCO status.

Chicago Mercantile Exchange, Inc.: CFTC-registered derivatives clearing organization; registry notes Title VIII SIDCO status. CFTC's current registered-DCO list identifies Chicago Mercantile Exchange, Inc. as registered.
ICE Clear Credit LLC: CFTC-registered derivatives clearing organization; registry notes Title VIII SIDCO status. CFTC's current registered-DCO list identifies ICE Clear Credit LLC as registered.
